# The Standard
> London-focused digital news publication covering breaking news, business, sport, culture, lifestyle, and entertainment.

The Standard, formerly the Evening Standard, is a major UK news site with extensive coverage of London alongside national and international reporting. Its core areas include news, sport, business, culture, lifestyle, property, and comment, with a mix of live blogs, analysis, reviews, and service journalism.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.standard.co.uk/): Front page for the latest London news, sport, culture, business, and entertainment.
- [News](https://www.standard.co.uk/news): Main news hub covering London, UK, world, politics, and breaking stories.
- [Sport](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport): Sports coverage including football, cricket, rugby, tennis, and live match reporting.
- [Business](https://www.standard.co.uk/business): Business, markets, personal finance, and City news from London and beyond.
- [Culture](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture): Arts and entertainment coverage spanning film, TV, theatre, music, and books.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle): Lifestyle features on food, travel, fashion, wellness, and relationships.
- [Homes & Property](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty): Property news, buying, renting, interiors, and London area guides.
- [Comment](https://www.standard.co.uk/comment): Opinion, editorials, and analysis from columnists and guest writers.

## News
- [London](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london): London news covering crime, transport, politics, weather, and local developments.
- [UK](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk): National news from across the UK, including policy, public services, and major events.
- [World](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world): International news, conflict coverage, diplomacy, and global affairs reporting.
- [Politics](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/politics): UK political news, Westminster developments, elections, and policy analysis.
- [Crime](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/crime): Crime reporting focused on London incidents, policing, courts, and public safety.
- [Transport](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/transport): Updates on TfL, rail, Tube, roads, strikes, and commuter disruption.
- [Health](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/health): Health reporting on the NHS, public health, research, and medical developments.
- [Weather](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/weather): Weather forecasts, warnings, and disruption affecting London and the UK.

## Sport
- [Football](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/football): Football news, live blogs, transfers, fixtures, and match analysis.
- [Cricket](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/cricket): Cricket coverage including England, county, and major international tournaments.
- [Rugby](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/rugby): Rugby union and league news, fixtures, and tournament reporting.
- [Tennis](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/tennis): Tennis news and live coverage from Wimbledon and major tours.
- [Boxing](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/boxing): Boxing news, fight previews, results, and analysis.
- [NFL](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/nfl): American football coverage with NFL news, fixtures, and London games.
- [Formula 1](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/formula-one): Formula One news, race coverage, standings, and driver updates.

## Business
- [Markets](https://www.standard.co.uk/business/markets): Market reporting, FTSE updates, company moves, and investor news.
- [Companies](https://www.standard.co.uk/business/companies): Corporate news, earnings, leadership changes, and business strategy coverage.
- [Economy](https://www.standard.co.uk/business/economy): Economic reporting on inflation, rates, growth, and public finances.
- [Money](https://www.standard.co.uk/business/money): Personal finance coverage including savings, mortgages, pensions, and tax.
- [Entrepreneurs](https://www.standard.co.uk/business/entrepreneurs): Startups, founders, innovation, and small business stories.
- [ESG](https://www.standard.co.uk/business/esg): Reporting on sustainability, governance, climate risk, and responsible business.

## Culture
- [Film](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/film): Film news, reviews, interviews, and festival coverage.
- [TV](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/tvfilm/tv): Television news, reviews, streaming guides, and interviews.
- [Music](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/music): Music news, album reviews, live coverage, and artist features.
- [Theatre](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/theatre): Theatre reviews, West End news, and stage features.
- [Art](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/art): Art news, exhibition reviews, and gallery coverage.
- [Books](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/books): Book reviews, author interviews, and literary features.
- [Comedy](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/comedy): Comedy reviews, stand-up coverage, and performer interviews.

## Lifestyle
- [Food & Drink](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/foodanddrink): Restaurant news, bar guides, recipes, and dining recommendations.
- [Travel](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/travel): Travel inspiration, hotel reviews, destination guides, and city breaks.
- [Fashion](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/fashion): Fashion news, trends, designer coverage, and style advice.
- [Beauty](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/beauty): Beauty product coverage, trends, treatments, and expert recommendations.
- [Wellness](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/wellness): Fitness, mental health, nutrition, and wellbeing features.
- [Sex & Relationships](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/sexandrelationships): Advice and features on dating, relationships, and modern intimacy.
- [Shopping](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/shopping): Product guides, gift ideas, and curated shopping recommendations.

## Homes & Property
- [Homes & Property Home](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty): Main property hub for London housing news and home inspiration.
- [Property News](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty/property-news): Housing market news, prices, mortgages, and development updates.
- [Buying](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty/buying-mortgages): Guides to buying homes, mortgages, and first-time buyer issues.
- [Renting](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty/renting): Renting advice, tenant issues, and London lettings coverage.
- [Interiors](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty/interiors): Interior design ideas, renovation inspiration, and home styling features.
- [Luxury](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty/luxury): High-end homes, prime property, and luxury real estate features.
- [Where to Live](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty/where-to-live): Area guides and neighbourhood features for London home movers.

## Comment and Analysis
- [Comment Home](https://www.standard.co.uk/comment): Opinion pieces, editorials, and analysis on current affairs and culture.
- [Editorials](https://www.standard.co.uk/comment/editorials): The publication's editorial stance on major issues and public debates.
- [Columnists](https://www.standard.co.uk/comment/columnists): Regular opinion writing from named columnists and contributors.
- [Analysis](https://www.standard.co.uk/comment/analysis): Deeper explanatory pieces on politics, business, and social issues.

## London-Focused Coverage
- [London News](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london): Core reporting on the capital's politics, crime, transport, and communities.
- [Transport](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/transport): Dedicated commuter and transport disruption coverage for London readers.
- [Homes & Property](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty): London housing market reporting and practical property guidance.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/foodanddrink): London restaurant openings, reviews, and bar recommendations.
- [Theatre](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/theatre): West End and London stage coverage, reviews, and ticket-worthy picks.
- [Art](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture/art): London exhibitions, gallery openings, and visual arts reporting.

## Utility Pages
- [Latest News](https://www.standard.co.uk/latest): Reverse-chronological feed of the newest stories published by The Standard.
- [Newsletters](https://www.standard.co.uk/newsletters): Newsletter sign-up page for curated updates across major coverage areas.
- [Puzzles](https://www.standard.co.uk/puzzles): Games and puzzles including crosswords and other interactive diversions.
- [Authors](https://www.standard.co.uk/author): Directory of journalists, columnists, and contributors on the site.
